description: This script analyzes Android build manifest and blueprint files to classify modules into projects and groups, providing a summary of module distribution across projects.

classes.name: DirProjectMatcher
classes.description: Class for matching directory paths to project names based on a regex pattern.

classes.name: GitProject
classes.description: Class for categorizing modules into system-only, vendor-only, or both groups based on rules and attributes.

methods.name: parse_manifest_xml
methods.description: Parses an XML manifest to map directory paths to project names.

methods.name: parse_blueprint
methods.description: Parses Android.bp files to evaluate modules and fill in namespace information.

methods.name: DirProjectMatcher.__init__
methods.description: Initializes the matcher with sorted project directory items and compiles a regex for matching paths.

methods.name: DirProjectMatcher.find
methods.description: Finds the project name corresponding to a given directory path.

methods.name: GitProject.add_module
methods.description: Adds a module to the appropriate category based on its attributes and rule.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main function that orchestrates parsing arguments, processing manifest and blueprint files, classifying modules, and outputting results.
